```yaml
name: Validate Dotfiles

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y fish zsh shellcheck stow
          # Install Homebrew on Linux for Brewfile checks
          /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"
          echo 'eval "$(/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/brew shellenv)"' >> $GITHUB_ENV
          eval "$(/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/brew shellenv)"

      - name: Run shellcheck on shell scripts
        run: |
          find . -type f -name '*.sh' -exec shellcheck {} +

      - name: Fish syntax check
        run: |
          find . -type f -name '*.fish' -exec fish --syntax-check {} +

      - name: Zsh syntax check
        run: |
          find . -type f -name '*.zsh' -exec zsh -n {} +

      - name: Validate shared configuration files
        run: |
          if grep -q '^[^=]*=' .env; then
            echo ".env file is syntactically valid."
          else
            echo "❌ Invalid .env file."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate generated abbreviations
        run: |
          if cmp -s .config/fish/abbr.yaml .config/fish/abbr.fish; then
            echo "Abbreviations match."
          else
            echo "❌ Abbreviations mismatch."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Check environment variable conflicts
        run: |
          if env | awk -F= '{print $1}' | sort | uniq -d | grep -q .; then
            echo "❌ Duplicate environment variables detected."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "No duplicate environment variables."
          fi

      - name: Verify stow symlinks
        run: |
          stow -t . --no-folding -d . --check

      - name: Check Brewfile dependencies
        run: |
          if [ -f Brewfile ]; then
            brew bundle check --file=Brewfile
          else
            echo "No Brewfile found; skipping dependency check."
          fi

      - name: Run custom validation script
        run: |
          if [ -f scripts/validate.sh ]; then
            bash scripts/validate.sh
          else
            echo "❌ No custom validation script found."
            exit 1
          fi
```
